GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Senior Recruiter, Public Sector GTM, you'll build the go-to-market (GTM) teams that drive GitLab's growth across U.S. federal, state, local, and education customers. In this senior individual contributor role, you'll partner with Public Sector leaders across Sales, Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Professional Services, Field Operations, and Enablement, owning searches from intake through close. You'll build inclusive pipelines, use data and market insight to guide hiring decisions, and act as a trusted talent advisor to Public Sector leadership.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li>Manage full-cycle searches for Public Sector Account Executives, Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Sales Operations roles. Deliver against agreed recruiting goals and key metrics, with accurate, timely documentation in Greenhouse.</li> <li>Lead intake conversations to align hiring teams on role scope, segment, territory, quota and ramp expectations, citizenship and clearance requirements, interview plans, and timelines. Support Federal Civilian, Department of Defense, Intelligence Community, and State, Local, and Education searches.</li> <li>Build research-based, diversity-focused sourcing strategies for a constrained talent market. Balance applicants, passive talent, referrals, internal talent, veteran and military-transition talent, and targeted outreach, including candidates with active or previously held security clearances and experience with government agencies, systems integrators, and contract vehicles.</li> <li>Partner with Public Sector leaders on structured, equitable interviews with clear competencies and actionable feedback. Challenge assumptions and escalate risks or blockers early.</li> <li>Use talent-market research, compensation and on-target earnings (OTE) benchmarks, funnel metrics, and candidate feedback to shape search strategy.
